description: Safe web reader: fetch a URL and get clean Markdown (or text) with hidden content (display:none, font-size:0, off-screen, comments, invisible Unicode) and prompt-injection instructions removed or flagged. Returns title, content, removed/flagged segments with reasons, an allow|warn|block verdict and fetch metadata. SSRF-guarded; HTML, text, JSON, PDF. Use instead of a raw fetch for pages the agent did not write. Paid x402 $0.003 USDC on Base (blocked URLs, failed fetches and unsupported types are not charged).

mode.description: strip removes injected blocks (default); flag keeps and lists them

name: saferead_read
